sections.heading: Pooja Cancellations
sections.body:
• 7 or more days before pooja date: Full refund
• 3–6 days before pooja date: 50% refund
• Less than 3 days before pooja date: No refund

sections.heading: Room Booking Cancellations
sections.body:
• 48 hours or more before check-in: Full refund
• Less than 48 hours before check-in: No refund

sections.heading: Cancellation by Us
sections.body: In rare circumstances (natural calamities, temple closures, etc.), if we cancel your booking, a full refund will be issued within 5–7 working days.

sections.heading: Refund Process
sections.body: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5–7 working days.

sections.heading: How to Cancel
sections.body: Open the app, go to My Bookings, and select the booking you wish to cancel. Alternatively, contact us at pooja@trimbakeshwarpoojavidhi.in.

sections.heading: No-Show Policy
sections.body: If you do not show up for your booked pooja or room without prior cancellation, no refund will be issued.
